name: flacli
description: flacli for Claude Code: playlists and named albums onto disk through your own Nicotine+ (Soulseek) client and MusicBrainz, then a tidy library. Everything runs locally.

plugins.name: flacli
plugins.description: The three skills (playlist-sync, music-tidy, wiki-fill), the matcher agent, a session health check and a download monitor over the flacli command, which install.sh puts on PATH. Import playlists from TIDAL, Deezer, YouTube Music or an export file, or just name songs and albums; match them against your local library, fetch the missing tracks through Nicotine+ (Soulseek), file each one as it lands, write an M3U, tidy the library, and fill the empty artist bios and album wikis in Flaclify / Euphonica.
